cohort: The study included all gastroschisis cases identified in Finland from 1993 to 2014, encompassing live births, stillbirths, and terminations of pregnancy due to fetal anomalies.
finding: Gastroschisis showed a significant increasing trend in live birth prevalence in Finland from 1993 to 2014, with overall excellent survival rates despite relatively high abortion rates.
mod_finding: Most babies with gastroschisis were delivered by caesarean section.
followup_time: Up to 1 year for infant mortality
